events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The conflict between the US and Iran is escalating, with potential for further military action. This could lead to increased volatility in the oil market and global stocks. The situation is being closely monitored by investors and policymakers.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war could lead to higher oil prices, benefiting oil services companies. On the other hand, emerging markets could be negatively impacted by the increased uncertainty and volatility.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and geopolitical developments

events.exitStrategy: Exit if oil prices drop below $60/bbl or if a ceasefire is announced

events.title: US Interest Rate Hike
events.summary: The US Federal Reserve is considering an interest rate hike, which could impact the US economy and stock market. The decision will be made at the next Fed meeting.
events.reasoning: An interest rate hike could lead to higher yields on long-term bonds, negatively impacting the price of the TLT ETF. On the other hand, financial stocks could benefit from higher interest rates.
events.exitStrategy: Exit if the Fed decides not to hike interest rates

gains.conservativeNote: If the Fed hikes interest rates by 25bps
gains.extendedNote: If the Fed hikes interest rates by 50bps or more
